description: Whether two Minecraft mods ran together in the Modkeel lab, clashed, or were never tested together. Use it for "can I use X with Y?" or to check two suspects from diagnose_crash; for one mod's whole record, use get_mod_runs. Takes two mod ids in any order (from names, call search_mods first). Unknown ids are not an error: the verdict is untested, meaning no lab run, never a known conflict. With mc, only runs on that version count. clash wins if any run clashed. Returns the verdict and the runs behind it.

mc.description: Minecraft version to narrow the answer to, e.g. 1.21.1, 1.20.1 or 26.2. Omit it to get every version the lab ran; with it, only runs on exactly that version count.

mod_a.description: First mod. Lowercase mod id as the loader knows it (the Modrinth/Fabric/NeoForge id, e.g. sodium, create, entityculling), not the display name. Unsure of the id? Call search_mods first.

mod_b.description: Second mod, same format, e.g. iris.

name: check_mod_pair

data.description: Snapshot date and license of the lab data; attribute when quoting.

runs.description: The runs behind the verdict; env: server, client or clash.

detail.description: What the lab saw, in words.

source.description: Which lab check produced the run.

verdict.description: untested: no lab run, not a known conflict.

title: Do two mods work together
